title: AI Gateway and Analytics
description: LiteLLM is the front door for every app's LLM calls: requests, errors, fallbacks, tokens, latency, spend and Pi auto-routing (local vs paid). Langfuse holds the per-request traces.

options.content:
Pi asks LiteLLM for **`pi-auto`**. Local Qwen (`pi-classifier`) grades **every request**: SIMPLE and MEDIUM stay on **local Qwen (free)**, COMPLEX and REASONING go to **DeepSeek Flash on OpenRouter (paid)**. Repeating tool calls, prompts too big for Qwen, a failed classification or a vLLM outage also send the request to DeepSeek.

Pi's own cost readout prices every request as DeepSeek; the spend here is LiteLLM's.

panels.description: LiteLLM's estimate; OpenRouter billing is authoritative.

panels.description: One per pi-auto request. 0 while pi-auto traffic flows means nothing is being graded.

panels.title: Local vs paid
panels.description: Every completed pi-auto request, by the backend that ran it.

panels.title: Requests per hour by backend
panels.description: Orange bars are escalations to DeepSeek.

panels.title: Classifier failures
panels.description: Timeouts or errors. Each one routes that request to DeepSeek (paid).

panels.title: Decision time (average)
panels.description: Added to every pi-auto request. The classifier gives up at 30s.

panels.title: Decision time trend
panels.description: A climb toward the 30s line means classifications are about to time out.

panels.description: Hours with no bar stayed entirely on your own GPUs.
